graph.title: LEGO City 7936 Level Crossing (with Excavator)
notes: Minifigure pieces (hard hat, head, torso, legs; page 4) are not in the official parts list, so they are not modelled.

The booklet has two models: the excavator (bag 1) and the level crossing with signals and barriers (bag 2). They are not fastened together, so no joined edge links them. The excavator's rail wheels rest on the crossing track (pages 42-43), so contact edges link the two. The sticker sheet (b18) also ties the two together because it supplies stickers for both.
Stud-level ports are left null for most plate-on-plate joins because the pictures do not show exact stud positions. Ports are given for hinges, pins, clips, ball/socket, axle holes and the turntable.

The excavator cab (windscreen plus roof) is removable (page 23) and is modelled as hand-reversible studs. The bucket (b59) is an alternative to the hook (b56/b57). Both are shown on 30386 hinge.1 (page 24).
The lifting ring (b58) rests on the hook and on the 4th track (b78), which is only a display piece (page 41). These are contact edges only.
Grille pieces (2412b, 2877, 61409) are placed approximately from the small pictures on pages 9, 14 and 17. Piece counts match the inventory.
Stickers (b18) are attached to the chassis tiles, cab roof, arm, tail-light covers, signal faces and barrier tiles. They are one node with several edges.

The barriers are joined to the bracket with revolute freedom because they swing up and down (page 43). The excavator rail axles hinge on the chassis hinge plates (pages 42-43). The two crossing copies attach to the left and right tracks (b76 and b77) through the attach override.
